sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.Heard and perused the case diary.
2.This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973, for grant of bail during trial.

The applicant is facing trial in connection with Crime No.218/2023, dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Taal, District-Ratlam, for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 201 of IPC, 1860.
Applicant is in jail since 03.07.2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
In this case, main accused is Manoj who has obtained loan on the basis of forged documents.

Another main accused is Pintu Meena who has supplied the forged Krishnapal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75670066/
1 documents.

sentences.text: Allegation against the applicant is only to prepare those documents but on this point only the statements of co-accused persons namely Pintu Meena and Sanjay under Sections 27 of Evidence Act, is available against him from whom the seizure was made.
Hence, only on the basis of memorandum statements of co-accused, the applicant should not be kept in jail for a long time.
The applicant is in custody since 03.07.2023.
The conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, prayer was made for grant of bail to the applicant.
4 . Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed prayer but fairly submitted that the applicant has been made accused only on the basis of memorandum of co-accused persons.
Nothing has been recovered from this applicant.
But, he has also submitted that the hand writing is yet to be examined.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, mainly looking to the fact that the applicant has been made accused on the basis of memorandum of co-accused persons, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
